TakeDamageSfxType.rationale: Presentation only, per SHARED-FINDINGS section 4 (monster stream) and monster_state_machine guards N2/N5. DamageSfxType.Armor.

AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: Presentation only, per SHARED-FINDINGS section 4 (monster stream) and monster_state_machine guards N2/N5. The whole override body is `if (TestMode.IsOff) { FabricatorNormal.SetBotFallPosition(NCombatRoom.Instance.GetCreatureNode(Creature)); }` -- SetBotFallPosition (FabricatorNormal.cs:60-68) writes a Node2D's Position so the bot drops in from the right height. Read to the END before deciding, per the KinPriest N6 precedent: there is no mechanical statement in it at all. The sim has no override and needs none.

GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: Noisebot.cs:42-49 is one self-looping MoveState('NOISE_MOVE', NoiseMove, new StatusIntent(2)); fabricator.py:58-61 is identical with Intent(MoveType.STATUS_CARD). No branch state on either side.

guards.what: NoiseMove pile targets and ORDER (Noisebot.cs:51-71 vs fabricator.py:63-67)
guards.rationale: C# adds Dazed #1 to PileType.Discard (statusCards[0], Noisebot.cs:61) and Dazed #2 to PileType.Draw at CardPilePosition.Random (:64), in that order. The sim calls add_to_discard then add_to_draw (fabricator.py:80-83, re-verified 2026-08-04, was :66-67), same order, so the one random insertion happens at the same point in the sequence. The random slot is the part that could silently drift and does not: CardPileCmd.add_to_draw draws it from the SHUFFLE stream in parity mode (`crng.shuffle.randrange(count + 1)`, cmds.py:1685-1707, re-verified 2026-08-04, was :490-496) and converts the game index to the sim's reversed pile orientation, exactly mirroring CardPileCmd.cs:514. `target.Player ?? target.PetOwner` (:57) resolves to the one player in Ironclad-only scope, which is ctx.player.

guards.what: StatusIntent(2)'s CardCount -- was dropped by the sim's Intent, RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-04: now CARRIED
guards.rationale: STALE PREMISE CORRECTED: the sim's Intent dataclass (monsters/base.py:52-83, was cited at :36-59) has since gained a `status_count: int | None = None` field, and fabricator.py's Noisebot.build_machine now passes `Intent(MoveType.STATUS_CARD, status_count=self._NOISE_STATUS_COUNT)` (fabricator.py:71-77, was :58-61) -- its own code comment names this '5th site of monster/_intent_count_lost (13 of the mechanism's 18 sites are still open)', i.e. Noisebot is one of the FIVE sites SHARED-FINDINGS/base.py's docstring lists as already fixed (Aeonglass, Test Subject, The Insatiable, Vantom, Noisebot). Verdict changed from waiver('dropped') to faithful('carried') because the premise the old waiver rested on ('has no status-card count') is no longer true for this unit. Still UNOBSERVABLE either way today, same as before: StatusIntent.CardCount (StatusIntent.cs:20) is read only by GetIntentLabel/GetIntentDescription (a tooltip string), and on the sim side nothing reads status_count yet (the field's own docstring: only the STATUS_CARD flag bit is read, at full_env.py:571). The number of cards actually added is correct on both sides (2).

Noisebot is the only bot with no attack and no constructor power; its HP band 18/23 matches Stabbot and Zapbot but not Guardbot, and its AfterAddedToRoom is the synchronous visual-only form (contrast Zapbot's async one). Read independently, not inherited.
